name: @openharness/app
description: The Electron desktop app: multi-pane workspace over Schematic / Layout / Parts / Connections / Diagnostics views (spec §7). GUI is mandatory per the reference app.

scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n renderer,electron -c blue,green "npm run dev:renderer" "npm run build:electron -- --watch --preserveWatchOutput"
